title: Multi-dimensional Decomposition of Material Extraction Patterns: A Stylised Scenario Analysis of the MERCOSUR-EU Trade Agreement — Replication Materials

creators.name: Gómez, Raimundo Elías
creators.affiliation: National Scientific and Technical Research Council (CONICET), Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences, National University of Misiones, Argentina

description: Replication materials (data, analysis scripts, and figures) for the article 'Multi-dimensional decomposition of material extraction patterns: A stylised scenario analysis of the MERCOSUR-EU trade agreement'. Includes Non-negative Tensor Factorisation (NTF) of territorial material extraction from the GLORIA MRIO database (Loop060) for 31 countries (EU-27 and MERCOSUR-4), and a stylised scenario sensitivity analysis of the trade agreement in which the temporal loadings are perturbed by illustrative, tariff-schedule-informed shocks. Scenario effects are expressed in tonnage terms and are conditional on the assumptions; the ordering of affected material categories follows from the assumed concession ranking, holding in 84% of independent tariff-anchored shock draws but only 15% when the schedule is ignored. All publication figures are included.
